# CANDIDATE: NARROW_ORB_BREAK_VOL_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A tightly bound opening range (OR) indicates suppressed volatility and institutional indecision. A breakout above the OR high with above-average volume captures the imminent volatility expansion move, offering an asymmetric long opportunity during low-VIX morning sessions.

## Mechanism

Define the OR as the high-low of the first 30-minute bar (09:30-10:00 EST). If OR width < 0.5 × 20-day ATR, monitor for a bar that closes above OR high with volume > 1.5 × 20-bar average volume. Enter long at the close of that bar. Exit: initial stop at OR low (chart-stop); TP1 at 1.0R (risk = entry - OR low). If TP1 hit, move stop to breakeven and trail runner with 15% trailing-stop-percent of highest high since entry. Trade only 09:30-11:30 EST; avoid days with pre-market gaps >0.25% or news-driven volatility spikes (VIX >20).
